info.title: Ask Sage User API — Full Response Reference
info.description:
Ask Sage User API for account management, organization administration, billing, and platform configuration.

## Base URL
`https://api.asksage.ai/user`

## Authentication
Most endpoints require a valid JWT token sent in the `x-access-tokens` HTTP header. Secured endpoints show a padlock in Swagger UI / Redoc — click **Authorize** and paste your token once to apply it to every request.

Get a token from `/get-token-with-api-key` (your email + 64-character API key), then send it on each call:

`x-access-tokens: <your token>`

**No token required:** `/get-token-with-api-key`, `/register`, `/verify-email`, `/lost-pass`, and `GET /get-headers`.

Beyond a valid token, admin (`admin-*`) and superadmin (`superadmin-*`) endpoints require the caller to hold the matching role, and many identify the target user via an `email` field in the request body.
## Key Features
- **User Management** — Profile updates, API key management, login history
- **Chat Sessions** — Create, retrieve, and manage conversation history
- **Dataset Management** — Create datasets, manage permissions and assignments
- **Workbooks** — Organize research with sources and memos
- **Organization Admin** — User management, token allocation, usage reporting
- **Superadmin** — Platform-wide administration and analytics
